summary: Contestants analyze and interpret a human resources management scenario, then prepare and deliver an oral presentation demonstrating HR knowledge, professionalism, and communication skills. The event includes a preparation period, a timed presentation, and a Q&A session with judges. Scoring is based on delivery, organization, content knowledge, responses to questions, and adherence to event rules.
time_limits: No more than twenty (20) minutes preparation time
No less than three (3) and no more than five (5) minutes for oral presentation
No more than three (3) minutes judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at five (5) minutes
submission_requirements: Only the three (3) notecards may be used in the presentation room
The Human Resources Manual may not be used during the presentation
competencies: Communicate HR concepts and recommendations clearly and professionally using data, policy references, and supportive reasoning
Organize the presentation using a clear introduction, body, and conclusion to create a coherent and persuasive HR message
Use effective verbal and nonverbal delivery skills, including vocal variety, posture, gestures, and eye contact—to support confident and professional HR communication
Model professional behaviors that support the organization’s mission and values
Describe and apply workplace safety, health, and compliance requirements
Model ethical, legal, and responsible conduct by maintaining confidentiality, understanding liability, and supporting organizational integrity
Demonstrate technical HR knowledge across areas such as staffing, training, compliance, and employee relations
Analyze HR issues and apply relevant policies to develop fair, compliant, and effective solutions
Demonstrate respectful, fair, and professional interactions in workplace scenarios
Follow laws and professional guidelines to ensure your actions protect both yourself and the organization in HR settings
Respond to judge questions clearly and confidently, using BPA’s Human Resources Manual, scenario details, examples, and sound HR reasoning from your preparation

rubric.description: If no to the question, please stop scoring and provide a brief reason for the disqualification:
Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.

Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges' questions.
The presentation lasted no less than three (3) minutes and no more than five (5) minutes and the contestant did not use any materials other than those specified.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Finals may be part of the competition
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
The contestant will be given warnings via flash cards when there are two (2) minutes remaining and when there is one (1) minute remaining during the speaking time
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this judged event
